title: Sign in
intro: Enter your mobile number. We will send you a code by SMS.

errors.invalid_phone: Please check the number: it needs the international format, for example +7 700 000 00 00.
errors.rate_limited: Let us take a short pause. You can try again in a minute.
errors.invalid_code: That code did not match. Check the SMS and try again.
errors.flow_expired: This code has timed out. You can get a new one.
errors.auth_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.network: We cannot connect right now. Check the internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Could not sign in. Try again.

demo.banner: Demo mode: no SMS provider is connected yet. Code for the demo number: {{code}}
demo.waiting: Demo mode: waiting for the demo number's code…
demo.numbers: Demo: use a number from +7 700 000 00 00 to +7 700 000 00 99.
